SUBTITLE (22-26%): two centered lines in black rounded sans-serif medium weight: 'Centraliza la grasa mal ubicada y la lleva a caderas, glúteos y piernas tonificadas.' BADGES (26-31%): two black rectangles with yellow borders side by side; left one with a yellow wheat icon and 'GLUTEN' (small white) over 'FREE' (bold yellow); right one with a yellow sugar-cube icon and 'SUGAR' over 'FREE'. CENTER (31-100%, right two-thirds): an ultra realistic adult Latina woman in her late 20s, long straight dark brown hair with loose strands, warm tan skin with real texture and pores, natural makeup, toned fit body with a small waist and curvy hips and thighs, wearing a black sports bra and black high-waist fitted shorts, standing in a three-quarter pose facing the camera, left arm raised with hand behind her head, looking at the camera, soft bright studio light from front-left, 50mm lens at waist height. LEFT COLUMN (34-68%): four stacked black circles with thin yellow line icons (flat abdomen, waist with two inward arrows, hips silhouette, glutes silhouette), each followed by a bold condensed black zone name and two lines of small black body text: 'ABDOMEN' / 'Apariencia más plana y estilizada.'; 'CINTURA' / 'Mayor definición visual.'; 'CADERAS' / 'Apariencia más pronunciada.'; 'GLÚTEOS' / 'Mayor volumen visual y realce.'. CALLOUTS: yellow rounded pills with black outline and black bold condensed text connected by thin yellow lines ending in yellow dots on the model: 'ABDOMEN' (right, at 50% height, pointing to her belly), 'CINTURA' (right, 58%, pointing to her waist), 'CADERAS' (left-center, 70%, pointing to her hip), 'GLÚTEOS' (left-center, 76%, pointing to her upper thigh/hip side). BOTTOM LEFT (78-88%): '¡EN 4 SEMANAS!' in black heavy condensed caps on two lines, the '4' huge in yellow #FFE01B, with a yellow brush swoosh underline. BOTTOM LEFT (90-99%): a gold circular seal with a thin dark border reading 'GARANTÍA' / '90' (large) / 'DÍAS' with three small stars, next to a yellow rounded pill reading 'DEVOLUCIÓN DE DINERO' in black bold caps. BOTTOM RIGHT (63-98%): the product from the attached product image, used as the only source of truth: an amber brown glass dropper bottle with a black ribbed cap and black rubber dropper bulb, about 1.6 times taller than wide with round shoulders, standing upright on a yellow cylindrical podium, label facing the camera and readable, matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Yellow label with white band: at the top of the label the brand word printed in black lowercase bold rounded sans-serif reads exactly 'amuna' (five letters: a-m-u-n-a), same size and position as on the original label; below it 'VITALDROPS' in white bold caps, 'All-in-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', ingredient circles A, F, L, MA, BR, and 'Dietary Supplement | 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'. Do not redesign the bottle in any other way.
